composition_variation: Design an original 28-year-old anime woman with a short black bob and warm brown eyes, standing on a quiet rooftop with one hand on her hip. Dress her in an opaque emerald tailored pantsuit and high-neck cream blouse. Use bold editorial cel shading, pale jade sky, terracotta parapets, and a low frontal camera. Her confident expression and grounded posture are stylish and completely nonsexual. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
